title: infra-ontology answer, v1
description: The citation record that comes with every answer: the query, the snapshot it ran against, the engine, the size and hash of the result, and the limits of the data. An answer is evidence, not a claim: a reader can re-run the query against the snapshot and compare result_hash.

query_hash.description: sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of the normalised query text and its parameters.

stored_query.description: The name of the stored query, if the query came from queries/.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot_id of the snapshot the query ran against.

dialect.description: The SQL dialect, for example infra-ontology/sql/v1.

engine.description: The engine and its version, for example duckdb 1.2.0.

truncated.description: True if the row cap cut the result.

result_hash.description: sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of the result in a canonical form.

limits.description: What the data behind the answer cannot tell you.

oldest_source.description: When the oldest source was read.

failed_sources.description: The number of sources that did not read in full.

uncovered_types.description: Types the snapshot could not read.
